verdict.rationale: Tether is Open WebUI's own feature for connecting the assistant to another computer, bringing that machine's files, tools and local models into chat. That is a thin form of the assistant reaching beyond one machine. Nothing shows phone pairing or the specific device actions the story names; the PWA install and chat-ready webhooks are only access and notification plumbing, not device control. Missing for 10: paired phone/mobile nodes, screenshot capture, camera access, device notifications, media playback control, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback

citations.quote: It brings your files, tools, and local models into chat, with an optional workspace sandbox to choose where the AI can work.
